/de/en/book-and-manage/timetable-and-fli.text: Flights delayed and cancelled at short notice We do our very best always to get you to your destination reliably and on time. However, air traffic disruptions can still occur, your departure gate may change, your flight might be delayed, or might even have to be cancelled. Rapid help Compensation Lufthansa app FAQs Rapid help in the event of delay or cancellation of my flight If this is the case, we will inform you about any flight changes via email or text message or the Lufthansa app and rebook you automatically if required. Please ensure that you have stored your current contact details in My bookings. If you have booked your flight ticket via a tour operator or in a travel agency, you can also contact the tour operator or travel agency directly. To the Lufthansa app In the event of last-minute rebooking Was your flight cancelled at short notice? You can use our Help Center to check if you have already been rebooked, or choose an alternative flight yourself and rebook free of charge. Rebooking via Help Center Rapid help with your ticket refund Has your flight been changed or cancelled? With our Help Center you can get your ticket refunded quickly and easily. Refund via Help Center Alternative transport with Deutsche Bahn If your Lufthansa flight has had to be cancelled at short notice, and we cannot offer you a suitable alternative flight, you can convert your flight ticket into a Deutsche Bahn rail ticket on certain routes free of charge. Information about alternative transport by rail Baggage transfer in the event of flight cancellation If you are rebooked, we will arrange your baggage transfer. In the event of a flight cancellation at short notice and onward journey by train or bus, we will endeavour to arrange a fast baggage reclaim. Please refer to the display boards and announcements for further information. Passenger rights If your flight was cancelled or faces a significant delay, or if you were denied boarding on a flight for which you had a confirmed booking, as a passenger you are entitled to rights under Regulation (EC) No. 261/2004. To Passenger Rights Compensation in the event of delayed and cancelled flights If your flight was delayed or cancelled or your baggage arrived late, you may be entitled to compensation. Meal voucher You are entitled to receive a meal voucher if your flight is delayed for two hours or more, if it is cancelled, or if you are denied boarding. The voucher is then automatically linked to the QR code on the boarding pass of the affected flight. More about the meal voucher Meeting the costs of an overnight hotel stay If your departure is postponed to the following day, we will arrange your overnight stay in a hotel. More about the reimbursement of overnight stay costs. Up to date with the app Stay well informed from booking to arrival: the Lufthansa app supports you at every step of your journey. In the event of flight delays or cancellation at short notice, you will find the most important information and direct help. To the Lufthansa app Frequently asked questions and answers Lufthansa will automatically rebook you free of charge on an alternative flight to the same destination and in the same travel class. In some cases, Lufthansa may not be able to rebook you proactively on an alternative flight. If this is the case, you can select an alternative yourself. This is also possible if an alternative booked automatically by Lufthansa does not suit your plans. Using the Lufthansa Chat Assistant, you can check if you have already been rebooked automatically or select an alternative yourself and rebook free of charge. Alternatively, you can view and manage your booking at "My bookings". To the Lufthansa Chat Assistant To My bookings More questions and answers on rebooking cancelled or postponed flights If you booked your flight ticket via a tour operator or travel agency, you may not be able to rebook directly. In this case, please contact your tour operator or travel agency. Loading... If your Lufthansa-operated flight has been cancelled, you can have your ticket refunded. Using the Lufthansa Chat Assistant, you can check your refund amount and process the refund. Alternatively, you can request a refund of the ticket via the link below. If you booked your flight ticket via a tour operator or travel agency, we recommend you contact them directly. To the Chat Assistant To manual refund If you have already submitted your request for a refund by phone or email, please do not request the refund again, as this may cause a delay in the processing of your request. If your ticket has not been used, the ticket price including all taxes and fees will be refunded to the original method of payment. If you have already used one or more segments of the journey, the unused portion of the fare value, taxes, and fees will be calculated, and the ticket refunded accordingly on a pro-rata basis. Loading... You will receive a meal voucher if your flight has been delayed by at least two hours, has been cancelled, or you have been denied boarding. You can redeem the voucher in numerous restaurants at the airport; you can find an overview of participating restaurants here: iCoupons worldwideThe link will be opened in a new browser tab To receive your meal voucher, you no longer need to visit the service counter in person. Please note that only the boarding pass for the affected flight is valid as a meal voucher. In addition, we will also let you know about your voucher and its value by email, text message, or push notification in your LH app. All the information about the new meal voucher has been summarized for you in this video. If your departure is postponed to the following day, we will arrange your overnight stay in a hotel. Please check if you have already received information about this via email or text. If you prefer, you can book a hotel yourself and submit the costs for the overnight stay, transport between the airport and hotel, and meals for reimbursement. Lufthansa will assume the costs for these, provided they are reasonable. If you pay for the hotel yourself, please send us your hotel, transport, and catering receipts as well as your boarding pass, and provide your bank details (IBAN and BIC) using our feedback form. To the feedback form If your flight is cancelled and no alternative flight is available, your ticket may be exchanged for a Deutsche Bahn train ticket through our Good for Train service. This service applies to flights within Germany and between Germany and the following destinations: Amsterdam, Brussels, Luxembourg, Paris, Basel, Geneva, Zurich, Salzburg, Vienna, Innsbruck, Linz, Graz, Budapest, Prague and Warsaw. Eligible passengers are identified automatically up to five days before departure and notified via email. In the event of a flight cancellation, it is also possible to manually request and redeem a voucher at any time. Important advice about cancelled feeder flights: When choosing your train, please make sure you allow sufficient time to catch your connecting flight from Frankfurt or Munich. To Good for Train Depending on availability, you may also be rebooked onto a Lufthansa Express Rail connection with Deutsche Bahn.You can view your confirmed connection under My bookings. To My bookings Please check in as usual from 24 hours before the start of your trip via our online check-in. To online check-in For transfer connections, please also check in for the train connection even if you decide to travel to Frankfurt or Munich by another means of transport. /de/en/during-your-trip/lounges.solo_con.text: Welcome to our lounges We look forward to welcoming you into our Lufthansa lounges as our guest. You can find out from our lounge directory which lounges are open and which services we are able to offer you at the respective airports. This is where we also give you information about lounge opening times and their location in the airport. Loading... Lounge news From October 2025 until the end of 2026 the Lufthansa Lounge in Washington D.C. will undergo extensive renovation. In the meantime, passengers of Lufthansa Group airlines will have access to the following lounges: Turkish Airlines Lounge for First Class and Business Class guests, HON Circle Member, and Senators (Concourse B, opposite Gate B42)British Airways Lounge for First Class guests and HON Circle Member (Gate B50)United Polaris Lounge for First Class and Business Class guests (Concourse C, between Gates C14 and C18)United Club Lounge for First Class and Business Class guests, HON Circle Member und Senators (Concourse C, between Gates C14 and C18) With ITA Airways as a new member of the Lufthansa Group, the lounge offering is also expanding. First and Business Class guests and status customers benefit from harmonised lounge access. Travellers with access rights can now also use the ITA Airways lounges in Rome-Fiumicino, Milan-Linate and Catania-Fontanarossa, among others. For more detailed information on the additional ITA Airways lounges, access regulations and our extended lounge network, please refer to the lounge directory above. Please note that different access rules may apply in individual cases during the harmonisation phase. The First Class Terminal and the First Class lounges in Departure Areas A and B are now available to our HON Circle Members who have flight connections with Discover Airlines. Whether it’s a business partner or family member, HON Circle Members, Senators and Star Gold passengers can continue to take companions with them into Lufthansa Group lounges and Star Alliance lounges worldwide in accordance with the rules already in place. Since 3 May 2021, these companions must be travelling on the same flight. More information on taking companions into the lounge At the airport: Of course, you can also visit the Lufthansa lounges as an Economy Class passenger (limited availability). To do so, present your valid Lufthansa boarding pass at the lounge entrance and simply pay by credit card or book lounge access online before your trip. Online: Book lounge access online The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. There is currently limited lounge capacity available in Frankfurt or Munich. Eligible Lufthansa First Class passengers departing from São Paulo can enjoy complimentary access to the exclusive BTG Pactual Terminal at GRU Airport. The experience includes private entrance, dedicated check-in, enhanced privacy and individual transfer to the aircraft, redefining the premium journey from the very first moment. For more information about access conditions and eligibility, please visit our dedicated page. Learn more about the BTG Terminal experience Access to our lounges Find out about the admission rules that apply to each of our lounges. Your lounge access depends on the booking class of your flight ticket or the privileges afforded by your status. Lounge admission rules An overview of our lounges Business Lounge You’ll receive a warm welcome here: Lufthansa staff are available in the reception area to deal with any requests you may have and to provide you with information about your lounge stay and your onward flight. Magazines and daily newspapers are available for you to read, and the lounge buffet offers you beverages and fresh food around the clock. Put together a plate of your favourite food and enjoy it at the bar. If you want to freshen up while you wait, you’ll find spacious shower cubicles, fresh hand towels and a hairdryer in the bathrooms. In the Comfort Zone, you can choose a seat that matches your mood and how much time you have: benches for a quick sit-down or a seat at a table to dine. Almost every seat in the Lufthansa lounge offers you great views of the runway. And from the armchairs directly facing the window, you can enjoy an exclusive view of jets taking off and landing. Senator Lounge You’ll feel at ease straightaway: in the Quiet Room, for example, which is located at the rear of the lounge away from the busy areas, you can relax on comfortable leather loungers, pleasantly shielded from view. Or why not stretch out on the exceptionally comfortable recliners in front of the panoramic windows? If you would like a meal – by yourself, with a partner or in a group – Lufthansa will offer you the appropriate table. And if you have work to do, no problem. Just move into your temporary office in our Work Area – we provide pleasant light to work by, a comfortable chair and all the necessary data connections. You can use your personal service at any time: Lufthansa staff are available at the reception desk. They are available to answer any questions you may have about your journey or the Lufthansa lounges. Also, if you would like to smoke, you have the opportunity to enjoy a relaxed stay in the separate lobby at the entrance to the Senator Lounge. Welcome Lounge On long-haul flights, would you like to sleep through the night and start the day feeling refreshed and well-rested? Not a problem with a stopover in the Lufthansa Welcome Lounge. First and Business Class passengers as well as status customers and United Airlines Global Services Card members can enjoy use of this lounge service provided that they have arrived in Frankfurt on a selected flight. A cosy bistro area, a breakfast buffet offering a varied selection, comfortable armchairs, a Quiet Zone and a smokers’ room, work stations, bathrooms and numerous showers ensure that you can relax after your flight and start your day refreshed. For First Class passengers, HON Circle Members and Senators there is also an exclusive ironing service available. Free Wi-Fi in the lounges In all Lufthansa lounges worldwide, you have access to a Telekom Hotspot (network name: Telekom_LH-Lounge) free of charge. Thanks to high transfer speeds, you can go online easily and reliably – from anywhere in the lounge. How to use our lounges Taking pets with you You are also welcome to take your four-legged friends with you into our lounges. Please understand, however, that out of consideration for our other guests, your dogs or cats should not be allowed to wander freely around Lufthansa lounges and should await their onward journey in their carrying container or pet carrier. Find out more about transporting pets

/de/en/prepare-for-your-trip/baggage/tra.text: Transporting animals in the aircraft You can take your dog or cat with you on Lufthansa flights. Please read the following information carefully before booking a flight with your pet. A good trip for your precious pet Depending upon the kind of animal, its weight and size, and the regulations applicable in different countries, transport is possible at an extra cost either as additional carry-on baggage in the passenger cabin or as excess baggage in the passenger aircraft’s air-conditioned cargo hold. Lufthansa Cargo also offers the transport of the above-mentioned animals and other species as air freight. Special rules apply to assistance dogs. Please note that because of local circumstances and restrictions, the transport of large animals in the cargo hold to certain destinations is not possible. General advice on transporting animals on Lufthansa flights Please note the minimum age of the animals to be transported. For dogs and cats the minimum age is: 12 weeks,and 15 weeks for carriage from/to/via Germany.If you are travelling to the USA: 6 months for dogs Please make sure that you find out about the import and export regulations applicable to your pet in your departure, transit and destination countries in plenty of time and before booking your flight. Such information is available from the relevant consulates, for example. Please also ask your vet about applicable animal welfare provisions for travelling with your pet. Obtain all the travel documentation required for your pet so that nothing will stand in the way of your trip. In the event of Lufthansa having to refuse the carriage of your pet because of non-compliance with the regulations, Lufthansa is not liable for any resulting costs (e.g. rebooking charges, animal boarding costs, hotel accommodation). Lufthansa also reserves the right to refuse to transport animals in the cargo hold if there are extreme weather conditions at the destination. This can happen at short notice or seasonally. Please note: each passenger is allowed to take a maximum of two animals with them (in an approved transport container). The animals may not be intended for commercial purposes. Animals can be transported in the cabin and/or in the cargo hold: 2 animals of the same species in the cabin in a pet carrier, or1 animal in the cabin and 1 animal in the cargo hold, or2 animals in the cargo hold in 2 separate transport containers, or2 animals of the same species in the cargo hold in one transport container. Special animal welfare provisions apply to the transport of several animals in one transport container: A maximum of 2 adult animals of comparable size that are used to each other and weigh up to 14 kg each may travel in one cage. Up to 2 weaned puppies or kittens may travel in one transport container if they come from the same litter, are not older than 6 months, and each weighs no more than 14 kg. Please make sure you find out about any differing country-specific regulations, where applicable. Your pet must be healthy: it must not show any visible signs of illness (e.g. diarrhoea, vomiting) and must not have any injuries or bandages. Lufthansa does not accept pregnant animals. Please note that if you are travelling to the USA you must register your dog with us using an online form and you must also fill out the CDC Dog Import Form. Registering an animal for carriage To register the carriage of an animal in the cabin or in the hold please use the appropriate online form: Registering pets for carriage in the cabin on USA flights Registering pets for carriage in the hold on USA flights Please note that if you are travelling to the USA with your dog you must also fill out the ​CDC Dog Import FormThe link will be opened in a new browser tab. CDC entry requirements The CDC entry requirements for dogs to the USA have changed as of 1 August 2024. To the CDC entry requirements (English) The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. Due to changes to the entry requirements of the American health authority Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), until further notice Lufthansa is accepting new bookings for dogs travelling to the USA only for travel to Atlanta, Los Angeles, Miami, New York-JFK, Philadelphia and Washington DC. Since October 2024, the transport of dogs to Newark (EWR) is possible again, provided that your dog has not been in a high-risk area (rabies) in the last six months before entering the USA. The transport of animals as air freight to other destinations is also still possible. For this, please contact an animal freight forwarder. Please familiarize yourself with the new requirements in good time and register your animal for your flight. CDC Dog Import Form In preparation for your dog’s trip, you must also complete the online form provided by the American authorities, the ‘CDC Dog Import Form’. After you have submitted this form, confirmation will be sent to the email address you have provided. On the day of departure and when entering the USA, you must present this confirmation in digital or printed form. To the CDC Dog Import Form (English) The link will be opened in a new browser tab To the CDC form explanations (English) The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. If you do not comply with the CDC entry requirements, we must unfortunately refuse transport. Lufthansa is not responsible for any costs incurred as a result (e.g. rebooking costs, accommodation costs for the animal, hotel accommodation). We apologise for any inconvenience. Assistance dogs The transportation of assistance dogs remains possible, provided all the CDC entry requirements are fulfilled. You can find detailed information on the CDC websiteThe link will be opened in a new browser tab. It is the passenger’s responsibility to fulfil all the requirements. Failure to present the documents required by the CDC upon check-in will result in import/transport being refused. To the information about travelling with assistance dogs All the regulations mentioned here apply exclusively to flights operated by Lufthansa. For code-share flights, therefore, please make sure that you check the regulations of the airline operating the flight. If you are travelling with several airlines, please ensure you have confirmation from all the airlines concerned that they will also transport your pet. Your pet must be registered in good time and have been confirmed by Lufthansa, i.e.: up to 72 hours before departure online or via your travel agency, or24 hours before departure at the latest in the Lufthansa Service Center. For assistance dogs, the deadline of 48 hours before departure applies. As the allocation is limited, we recommend that you book your pet in early, preferably at the same time as you book your own flight. Register your pet for carriage in the cabin Register your pet for carriage in the cargo hold Information on the carriage of fighting dog breeds and snub-nosed animals If possible, get your pet used to its transport container at home before the journey by putting it into the closed transport container several times for about two hours at a time and rewarding it afterwards with a treat.Many pets are very nervous before and during a flight. Nevertheless, you should think very carefully about whether you wish to tranquillize your pet with medications. This makes it difficult to predict how your animal may react. It can, for example, cause circulatory problems during the flight. Please ask your vet’s advice about this.Put your pet’s "comfort blanket" and its favourite toy in the transport container in order to soothe and calm it with familiar smells.Ask your vet how to adapt your pet’s food for the flight, if necessary. Online and mobile check-in 30 hours before departure is possible for all passengers travelling with animals. Passengers travelling with their animal in the cabin must collect their boarding pass at the check-in counter at the airport. The boarding pass for passengers whose animals are travelling in the hold is issued during online/mobile check-in. These passengers cannot check in their baggage at self-service bag-drop kiosks. You are also welcome to take your four-legged friends with you into our lounges. Please understand, however, that out of consideration for our other guests, your dogs or cats should not be allowed to wander freely around Lufthansa lounges and should await their onward journey in their transport box or pet carrier. Assistance dogs are exempt from this regulation. Learn more about entry to our lounges. What travel options are there for the different types of animals? Only smaller dogs and cats weighing no more than 8 kg including their transport container may be transported under certain conditions as additional carry-on baggage in the passenger cabin. Larger dogs and cats, and all other animal species regardless of their weight and size, are not allowed in the cabin. For all flights (excluding the USA) You can register to take your pet with you into the cabin yourself under My bookings. We recommend that you make your booking at least 72 hours before departure. Otherwise, please contact the Service Center up to 24 hours before departure. Lufthansa also reserves the right to apply stricter regulations where necessary and refuse bookings on certain routes (such as to the UK or Ireland, for example) to exclude the animal from travel. Go to My bookings For USA flights For flights from or to the USA, you must register at least 72 hours before departure via the following form. Due to these restrictions, it is not currently possible to register via the Service Center. Registering pets for carriage in the cabin on USA flights For you to take your pet into the cabin as carry-on baggage, we require your confirmation for all flights that the animal meets the stated requirements. Please present two printouts of the completed and signed form at the check-in counter to confirm this. Please note that the form is not required for assistance dogs on direct flights to/from the USA. Form for carriage of an animal in the passenger cabin Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. Further information on the carriage of animals in the cabin Dogs and cats weighing more than 8 kg including their transport container may be carried as excess baggage in the aircraft’s air-conditioned cargo hold under certain conditions. You must register using the following online form no later than 72 hours before departure. Otherwise, please contact the Service Center up to 24 hours before departure. For USA flights For flights to the USA, you must register at least 72 hours before departure using the following form. Register your pet for carriage in the cargo hold ​More information about the carriage of animals in the cargo hold For the carriage of all other animals, please contact ​Lufthansa Cargo. You can take your assistance dog with you on board Lufthansa flights free of charge. Please find out about the general requirements for taking an assistance dog into the aircraft cabin with you. Learn more about assistance dogs Special regulations apply to taking fighting dog breeds with you when you fly. More information about the carriage of fighting dog breeds Dogs and cats belonging to snub-nosed breeds have anatomically restricted airways with the accompanying difficulty in breathing. For this reason, there are special instructions and rules for transporting these animals. More information about the carriage of snub-nosed animals If you are unable to travel together with your pet, if country regulations stipulate that animals must be transported by air freight, or if you would like to transport an animal not listed on lufthansa.com, it is possible to have your animal transported as air freight. Varying prices apply to shipping animals as air freight (for example, with Lufthansa Cargo). For this, you need a carrier who specialises in transporting animals. You can find the contact details of one near you with the help of the animal freight forwarder search. Search for animal freight forwarders The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. You can contact them in Germany on tel. 0180 6 – 747 100 (calls cost €0.20 per min. from the German landline network; max. €0.60 per min. from mobile phone networks). /de/en/common/passenger-rights.solo_cont.text: Passenger rights Dear passengers, If your flight has been cancelled or significantly delayed, or if you have been denied boarding on a flight for which you have a confirmed booking, you are entitled to the rights set out in Regulation (EC) No. 261/2004, which came into force on 17 February 2005. The airline on which flight the disruption occurs is responsible for granting your rights. Refunds In case you have a USA ticket, the US DOT refund regulations may also apply. To the US DOT Refund regulations (English only) The link will be opened in a new browser tab Validity The Regulation shall apply to passengers whose scheduled flight departs from an EU Member State or to passengers whose scheduled flight departs from a third country with an EU airline scheduled to arrive in an EU country, provided that the passengers have not received compensation or financial assistance in that third country, only on condition that you have a confirmed reservation for the flight in question, only (except in the case of a cancelled flight) on condition that you present yourself at check-in at the time indicated or, if no time is indicated, no later than 45 minutes before the posted departure time, only on condition that you are travelling on a fare offer that is open to the public. Delays According to Regulation (EC) 261/2004, a delay is deemed to have occurred if the scheduled departure time is delayed by at least four hours for flights of more than 3,500 km, by at least three hours for flights between 1,500 and 3,500 km and for flights of more than 1,500 km within the EU, and by two hours for flights of up to 1,500 km. If your flight is likely to be significantly delayed, you have the right to receive care from the airline. This includes: Meals and refreshments (in reasonable proportion to the waiting time), potentially hotel accommodation including transport costs and the opportunity to make two short telephone calls or send two faxes or emails. The airline is not obliged to do this if you are responsible for a further delay to your departure. In the event of delays of more than five hours, you are entitled, within seven days, to a refund of the price of the ticket in the amount of the tour not taken or in the amount of the tour already taken if the purpose of the tour could not be achieved due to the delay and, if applicable, to a return flight to the first departure location at the earliest possible time. You are entitled to compensation if your arrival at your destination airport is delayed by more than three hours and the delay cannot be attributed to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided by taking all reasonable measures. Such circumstances include poor weather conditions, political instability, strikes, security risks and unexpected deficiencies in flight safety. Overbooking If you are involuntarily denied boarding on a flight you have booked in the event of overbooking, you have the right to assistance from the airline as described above under “Delays”. In addition, you will be offered re-routing to the final destination of your booked flight. This re-routing shall take place at the earliest opportunity and under comparable conditions. Subject to seat availability, you may instead travel to your final destination at a later date of your choice. In this case, the costs for meals/refreshments, hotel and transport between the hotel and the airport are at your expense. If you are denied boarding involuntarily or voluntarily, you have the right to an alternative flight or to reimbursement and compensation, which can also be made by cheque or bank transfer or, with your consent, in the form of a gift card. The amount of this payment depends on the distance of the planned route and the re-routing offered to you: In the case of flight distances of up to 1,500 km, the compensation amounts to €250.00, between 1,500 and 3,500 km and for flights of more than 1,500 km within Europe the compensation amounts to €400.00, for more than 3,500 km the compensation amounts to €600.00. The distance is calculated based on the last destination to which the passenger arrives later than the scheduled arrival time because the passenger was denied boarding or the flight was cancelled. If you are offered an alternative flight and the arrival time is no later than two hours after the scheduled arrival time of the originally booked flight for flights of up to 1,500 km, no later than three hours after the scheduled arrival time for flights of between 1,500 and 3,500 km and no later than four hours after the scheduled arrival time for flights of more than 3,500 km, the compensation will only be 50% of the above amounts, i.e. €125.00, €200.00 or €300.00. You are not entitled to the compensation described above if you are justifiably denied boarding through your own fault, for health or safety-related reasons, or due to missing or insufficient travel documents. Cancellation If the flight for which you have a confirmed booking is cancelled, you have the same rights to re-routing, assistance, reimbursement and compensation as described above. However, you are not entitled to compensation as per the EU Regulation if the incident can be attributed to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken. Such circumstances include bad weather conditions, political instability, strikes by third parties, security risks and unexpected shortcomings in flight safety, for example. You are also not entitled to compensation if you were informed of the cancellation at least 14 days before departure, you were informed of the cancellation between 14 and 7 days before departure and your flight departs no more than two hours before the original departure time and/or you arrive no more than four hours after the scheduled arrival time, you were informed of the cancellation less than seven days before departure and your flight departs no more than one hour before the original departure time and/or you arrive no more than two hours after the scheduled arrival time. Downgrade If you are downgraded to a lower class, you have the right to receive compensation within seven days. The amount of this payment depends on the planned flight distance and the ticket price paid per segment; for flight distances of up to 1,500 km, the compensation amounts to 30% of the price per segmentbetween 1,500 and 3,500 km and for flights of more than 1,500 km within Europe, the compensation amounts to 50% of the ticket price paid per segmentof more than 3,500 km, the compensation amounts to 75% of the ticket price paid per segment. If you believe that you have a valid claim against Lufthansa based on the above terms, please contact us via “Lufthansa Feedback” or by post. /de/en/upgrade-info.solo_continue.text: General information about your upgrades Rebooking tickets If your journey includes a booked upgrade and you wish to rebook, please contact our Service Center. Unfortunately, for technical reasons such tickets cannot be rebooked on lufthansa.com. The conditions of your originally booked fare apply to the rebooking. To the Service Center Cancellation and refund of tickets If you wish to cancel your trip via lufthansa.com, please be aware that any amounts already paid for upgrades are not refundable. You can cancel your ticket and request a refund easily online. To My bookings You will find more information about cancellations and refunds in our FAQs. To the FAQs on cancelling a trip and getting a ticket refunded Services and entitlements in the event of flight disruptions In the case of disruptions to flights from two days before departure, the rebooking will be made within the original travel class on the original ticket’s fare conditions. The passenger will receive the full reimbursement of the upgrade payment. In the case of disruptions to flights that arise both one day before departure and on the actual day of departure, the passenger will be rebooked with the full services and entitlements of the new travel class (including confirmed and paid-for upgrades). H2: 1.3 Adding additional baggage is not valid for:
/de/en/common/baggage-conditions.solo_co.text: Terms and Conditions for booking additional pieces of baggage 1.1 General conditions Passengers have the option of booking additional pieces of baggage for a fee. 1.2 Eligibility conditions The offer only applies to passengers who have a booking with a flight number from Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, or Air Dolomiti, and where the flight is operated by Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, Discover Airlines or Air Dolomiti (or a wet-leasing partner) and to passengers with a valid ticket. For other operating airlines, baggage rules and fees may vary.The extra bag charge applies to one-way flights to the final destination.The booked baggage must not exceed the standard weight of 23 kg and the standard dimensions of 158 cm (H+L+W). For baggage that exceeds the standard weight or the standard dimensions, the applicable excess baggage rate will be calculated at the airport.The baggage booking does not apply to the transport of animals or to sports equipment.Additional baggage can be paid for at the time of booking your flight or after booking up to two (2) hours before departure via My Bookings.The number of items of baggage that you can book is restricted. Passengers can book up to five (5) additional pieces of baggage, depending on the route.In addition, one additional piece of baggage that exceeds the standard weight of 23 kg (max. 32 kg), or the standard size of 158 cm (max. 292 cm (H+L+W)), or both, can be booked.Additional baggage can also be booked at the airport either at the ticket desk or check-in desk at a higher price. The additional baggage fees are charged in the currency of the country you are departing from.Lufthansa reserves the right to change or to modify fares or the existing terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.The receipt for your extra bag booking must be retained up until the end of your journey, and must be presented upon request at the ticket or check-in desk at the airport . The receipt will be sent to you via email to the address given during the purchasing process.The additional baggage booking is only valid for the flight shown on the receipt on the stated date. If the flight is rebooked, the booked additional item of baggage is no longer valid, except under the circumstances described below under «Rebooking and refunds».Additional baggage booking charges are not refundable except under the circumstances described below under ‘Rebooking and refunds’.All baggage is transported in accordance with the Lufthansa General Terms and Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage. Special rules for booking additional items of baggage Continental flights: Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights: The Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights includes only one personal item (40 x 30 x 15 cm) that may be taken into the aircraft cabin. Passengers have the option to add one (1) piece of carry-on baggage with a maximum weight of 8 kg and dimensions of 55 x 40 x 23 cm for a fee, either online via My Bookings or through the Service Center.The Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights does not include any free checked baggage. Lufthansa offers the benefit of a reduced price for the first piece of checked baggage (23 kg, total dimensions 158 cm). This applies only to passengers holding a booking with a Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, or Air Dolomiti flight number, and whose flight is operated by Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, Air Dolomiti, or Discover Airlines (or a wet-lease partner).Miles & More members with HON Circle, Senators, as well as Star Alliance Gold status have the option of taking one piece of carry-on baggage into the cabin free of charge in addition to a personal item when traveling on an Economy Basic fare on short- and medium haul flights. Adding a second piece of carry-on baggage for a fee is not permitted. Economy Light fare The Light fare does not include a checked free baggage allowance. On the Economy Class Light fare, Lufthansa offers you the additional benefit of a discount on the first bag (23 kg, overall 158 cm). Applies only to passengers who have a booking with a flight number for Lufthansa/SWISS/Brussels/ Austrian Airlines or Air Dolomiti, where the flight is operated by Lufthansa/SWISS/Austrian/Brussels Airlines/Air Dolomiti or Discover Airlines (or a wet-leasing partner) and who hold a valid ticket for an Economy Light fare.Miles & More members with Frequent Traveller, Senator or HON Circle status, as well as Star Alliance Gold members, enjoy higher free baggage allowances. However, the higher free baggage allowances do not apply to flights with Economy Light fares. Intercontinental flights: Economy Light fare The Light fare does not include a checked free baggage allowance. On the Economy Class Light fare, Lufthansa offers you the additional benefit of a discount on the first bag (23 kg, overall 158 cm). Applies only to passengers who have a booking with a flight number for Lufthansa/SWISS/Brussels/ Austrian Airlines or Air Dolomiti, where the flight is operated by Lufthansa/SWISS/Austrian/Brussels Airlines/Air Dolomiti or Discover Airlines (or a wet-leasing partner) and who hold a valid ticket for an Economy Light fare.Miles & More members with HON Circle, Senator and Star Alliance Gold status on intercontinental routes* have the option of taking the first piece of baggage free of charge on the Economy Light fare. Free carriage can only be registered at the check-in counter. If the baggage on the Economy Light fares is booked online, via the Service Center or via a travel agency, corresponding charges will apply.On some flight routes**, you will benefit from reduced rates for a second item of baggage (23 kg, 158 cm dimensions) on the Lufthansa Economy fare.Miles & More members with Frequent Traveller, Senator and HON Circle status, as well as Star Alliance Gold members, can enjoy higher free baggage allowances. However, in this case and on these flight routes, the reduced booking fee for the second item of baggage does not apply; the regular price for additional baggage bookings applies to each additional checked item of baggage. However, the above-mentioned benefits do not apply to flights on the Economy Light fare. * This does not apply to flights to and from Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Lebanon and Syria. **Applies to flights to/from the USA, Canada, Mexico, Central America, Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and Panama. Premium Economy Light fare The Premium Economy Light fare includes one (1) checked free baggage allowance (23 kg, overall 158 cm).Miles & More members with HON Circle, Senator and Star Alliance Gold status have the option of taking a second piece of baggage free of charge on intercontinental routes* with the Premium Economy Light fare. Free carriage can only be registered at the check-in counter. If the item of baggage in the Premium Economy Light fares is booked online, via the Service Center or via a travel agency, corresponding charges will apply. * This does not apply to flights to and from Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Lebanon and Syria. Business Light fare The Business Light fare includes one (1) item of checked free baggage allowance (32 kg, overall 158 cm).Miles & More members with HON Circle, Senator and Star Alliance Gold status have the option of taking a second piece of baggage free of charge on intercontinental routes* on the Business Light fare. Free carriage can only be registered at the check-in counter. If the item of baggage on the Business Light fares is booked online, via the Service Center or via a travel agency, corresponding charges will apply. * This does not apply to flights to and from Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Lebanon and Syria. Lufthansa reserves the right to take legal action in the event of fraud. 1.3 Adding additional baggage is not valid for: infants under the age of 2 yearsflights offered or operated by airlines other than the Lufthansa Group. 1.4 Rebooking and refunds Additional baggage bookings can be transferred when changing an existing booking, provided that the fare conditions of the ticket allow for rebooking. However, it is not possible to transfer the extra baggage booking to another route, other passengers or other airlines.Additional baggage bookings are refundable: if Lufthansa is not in a position to transport your baggage due to a change of aircraft, cancellation or interruption to a Lufthansa flight orif your baggage cannot be transported for operational or security reasons that are not attributable to the passenger’s actions or omissions.Additional baggage bookings alone are not refundable if the flight is cancelled by the passenger.A refund is possible when cancelled together with the flight ticket, provided that the fare conditions of the ticket permit a refund.Refunds are made via the original method of payment used. 1.5 Baggage fees You can check your baggage allowance in just a few steps with our calculator – based on route, travel class and fare. To the baggage calculator The link will be opened in a new browser tab

/de/en/book-and-manage/advance-seat-rese.text: Advance seat reservation Whether it’s a window or aisle seat, or a seat with extra legroom, we offer you the option of reserving seats for yourself and your travelling companions in advance or at check-in. How do I reserve a seat? You can reserve your seat directly when booking your flight or at a later date. You can reserve a seat for a fee via My bookings up to two hours before departure. You will be allocated a seat automatically during online check-in if you do not choose a seat. You can change it for a fee, depending on the fare and seat category selected. This fee is not payable by passengers who have booked a seat in advance, providing the newly selected seat is of the same or a lower seat category. Reserve a seat now European flights (incl. Middle East and North Africa) Classic Seat Decide for yourself where you want to sit. Whether it’s a window or an aisle seat, we offer you the option of reserving your seat in advance. The price for reserving a Classic Seat depends on the length of your flight and your destination, and is free of charge on the Flex fare. Book Classic Seat now Preferred Zone Seat As a rule, the preferred seating area is located in the front part of Economy Class, directly behind Business or Premium Economy Class. These seats enable you to leave the aircraft quickly after landing, making your journey even easier and more flexible. The price of reserving a Preferred Zone Seat depends on the length of your flight and your destination. Book Preferred Zone Seat now Extra Legroom Seat We offer you the option of reserving seats with extra legroom on almost all aircraft types. Some of these seats are located in the emergency exit rows, so special conditions apply when booking these seats (see below). The price of reserving an Extra Legroom Seat depends on the length of your flight and your destination. Book Extra Legroom Seat now Back Seat The Back seat is the best choice for those looking for the most affordable option while still being able to choose their seat. Book Back Seat now Free Neighbour Seat Sometimes a little more personal space is just what you need. Treat yourself to extra comfort and simply book the seat next to you on continental and intercontinental routes. Go to Service Center We recommend you book the neighbouring vacant seat in the following circumstances: You would like more space for your personal comfortYou are not in a position to be seated in a single seat due to your physical buildYou are unable to fold down both armrestsYou cannot fasten your seat belt despite the use of a single seat belt extension Depending on the booking situation, you can reserve your adjacent seat and make sure that the seat is guaranteed to remain empty. Please call our Service Center to do this. Intercontinental flights Classic Seat Decide for yourself where you want to sit. Whether it’s a window or an aisle seat, we offer you the option of reserving your seat in advance. The price for reserving a Classic Seat depends on the length of your flight and your destination, and is free of charge on the Flex fare. Book Classic Seat now Preferred Zone Seat As a rule, the preferred seating area is located in the front part of Economy Class, directly behind Business or Premium Economy Class. These seats enable you to leave the aircraft quickly after landing, making your journey even easier and more flexible. The price of reserving a Preferred Zone Seat depends on the length of your flight and your destination. Book Preferred Zone Seat now Legroom Seat More personal space for maximum comfort in Economy Class. Make yourself comfortable in one of our ergonomic seats and enjoy about 8 cm more room compared to the Classic Seat. HON Circle Members and Senators can reserve a Legroom Seat free of charge. More information about Lufthansa Allegris Extra Legroom Seat We offer you the option of reserving seats with extra legroom on almost all aircraft types. Some of these seats are located in the emergency exit rows, so special conditions apply when booking these seats (see below). The price of reserving an Extra Legroom Seat depends on the length of your flight and your destination. Book Extra Legroom Seat now Duo Seat A window seat to take in the view or an aisle seat to move around without disturbing your travel companion? Our Duo Seats are ideal for those traveling as a couple. Book Duo Seat now The link will be opened in a new browser tab Back Seat The Back seat is the best choice for those looking for the most affordable option while still being able to choose their seat. Book Back Seat now Classic Seat Decide for yourself where you want to sit. Whether it’s a window or an aisle seat, we offer you the option of reserving your seat in advance. The price of reserving a Classic Seat depends on the length of your flight and your destination, and is free of charge on some fares. Look forward to individual and personal moments of wellbeing above the clouds in all travel classes and explore the new seating categories now. More information about Lufthansa Allegris Classic Seat The Classic Seat will quickly become your very own place of wellbeing, with a hard-shell seat that offers more privacy and extra comfort thanks to a small cocktail tray, and wireless charging for your devices. The armrest and leg support in fine leather and space for your personal belongings provide optimum comfort and convenience right at your seat. Book Classic Seat now European flights (incl. Middle East and North Africa) Classic Seat The comfortable Classic Seat on short- and medium-haul flights is located in the front rows of the cabin, and offers more legroom and additional working space. Depending on the fare, you can select your seat free of charge. Book Classic Seat now First Row Seat First Row seating in Business Class on continental routes offers the exclusivity and convenience of the very first row of the aircraft. Book First Row Seat now Intercontinental flights Classic Seat The seat can be converted into a fully flat bed on long-haul flights, and offers additional storage space for your personal belongings. Depending on the fare, you can select your seat free of charge. Book Classic Seat now A380 new Business Class Experience the A380 new Business Class with a modernized cabin design, all aisle access from every seat, and an expanded range of seating options. Enjoy a new level of comfort and flexibility on select routes. Privacy Seat in A380 More privacy and peace on your flight: The Privacy Seat is located directly by the window and offers a particularly private and quiet atmosphere thanks to its greater distance from the aisle. Sit back and enjoy your personal comfort zone in Business Class. Book your Privacy Seat now Extra Long Bed in A380* Experience the Extra Long Bed on our retrofitted A380 fleet. Offering plenty of space for those who wish to enjoy their flight to the full, the seat features an extra-long 2.12 to 2.22-metre bed to ensure a relaxing night’s sleep. The price for an Extra Long Bed depends on the length of your flight and your destination. Book Extra Long Bed now HON Circle Members can reserve an Extra Long Bed free of charge. *subject to availability Lufthansa Allegris seats Lufthansa Allegris is our promise to focus even more on you as our guest. Look forward to individual and personal moments of wellbeing above the clouds in all travel classes and explore the new seating categories now. More information about Lufthansa Allegris Business Suite The Business Class Suite with higher partitions and completely closable doors offers you plenty of privacy and peace and quiet thanks to its exclusive position in the first row. A personal suite with lots of space, your own wardrobe, generous storage, and a small minibar. A flexible partition can create a Double Suite from two adjoining single Business Suites. The price for a Business Suite depends on the length of your flight and your destination. Book Business Suite now Extra Space Seat The Extra Space Seat offers an exceptional amount of room. The spacious single seat with more space is perfect for relaxing, working, and dining. The generous extra storage space gives you easy access to your personal belongings, documents, and much more. The price for an Extra Space Seat depends on the lenghts of your flight, your destination, your fare and your frequent flyer status. Book Extra Space Seat now Extra Long Bed The Extra Long Bed offers plenty of space for those who wish to enjoy their flight to the full. The seat has an extra long, 2.2-meter bed to ensure a relaxing night’s sleep. A flexible screen between the seats gives you greater privacy. The price for an Extra Long Bed depends on the lenghts of your flight, your destination, your fare and your frequent flyer status. Book Extra Long Bed now Privacy Seat A Privacy Seat offers a high degree of privacy right by the window. The distance from the aisle provides more comfort and peace and quiet, like a personal retreat above the clouds. The price for a Privacy Seat depends on the lenghts of your flight, your destination, your fare and your frequent flyer status. And if you are travelling with an infant: the Privacy Seat in the last row can also be fitted with a baby bassinet. Book Privacy Seat now Classic Seat The redesigned classic: the Business Class Classic Seat offers you everything you need for a comfortable flight. Pleasant privacy, always with direct aisle access, with access to the window and an open lounge atmosphere – designed simply for relaxation. All seats have an integrated flexible privacy screen with storage and shelves for your drinks, clothes, or your latest reading matter. You can select a Classic Seat free of charge. Book Classic Seat now You will experience the greatest comfort on long-haul flights and the highest levels of privacy and comfort. In First Class, you can select your seat free of charge. Lufthansa Allegris seats Lufthansa Allegris is our promise to focus even more on you as our guest. That’s why we have redesigned our seats, cabins, and services from scratch. The first aircraft with this new travel experience will be joining our fleet from autumn 2024. Look forward to individual and personal moments of wellbeing above the clouds in all travel classes and explore the new seating categories now. More information about Lufthansa Allegris Suite Plus Whether you’re travelling alone or as a couple, the spacious and private Suite Plus offers everything you could wish for. Look forward to plenty of room, a wardrobe en suite, a large mirror, and maximum privacy to work or relax, with two individually controlled extra-wide seats that can be converted into a spacious single or a double bed. The price for a Suite Plus depends on the length of your flight and your destination. To book double occupancy, please contact our First Class hotline on: +49 69 867 99 444. Our First Class guests from the USA can call +1 855 427 4377. Suite A private suite with fully closable doors and 1.80-meter-high partitions gives you maximum privacy. Simply close the door and enjoy the view above the clouds. The extra-wide seat converts at night into a spacious bed to ensure you enjoy a relaxing night’s sleep. You may book the First Class Suite free of charge. Sleeper's Row in Economy Class Enjoy more comfort and space on your long-haul flight. With Lufthansa Sleeper’s Row, you can use an entire row of Economy Class seats on selected long-haul flights. After pre-boarding, you will receive a Sleeper’s Row kit on board, including a mattress topper, blanket and pillow in Business Class quality. Stretch out and relax for the duration of your flight. Sleeper’s Row can be booked for long-haul flights subject to availability, directly at a Lufthansa counter at the airport. Advance reservations are not possible. Important note: The Sleeper’s Row is not confirmed until boarding is complete. If the Sleeper’s Row cannot be provided due to a lack of available rows or operational, safety, or space-related reasons, we will refund the full amount paid for the service. Further information and details about advance seat reservation The flight must be operated by Lufthansa Group airlines, Lufthansa Regional (Air Dolomiti,Lufthansa City Airlines), Lufthansa Express Rail (DB), Edelweiss, or Discover Airlines.Your flight booking is confirmed (no waiting list bookings).If you did not select your seat during the booking process, you can also do so after completing your booking. Access your trip under My bookings, and book or change your seat there. Reserve a seat now You will be allocated a seat automatically during online check-in if you did not choose a seat in advance. You can change it for a fee depending on the fare and seat category selected. This fee is not payable by passengers who have booked a seat in advance, providing the newly selected seat is of the same or a lower seat category. Please note that a confirmed advance seat reservation does not guarantee you a specific seat on board the aircraft (e.g. seat 3A). It only refers to the category selected (e.g. Classic Seat, Preferred Zone Seat, Extra Legroom Seat, etc.). An advance seat reservation applies to a single leg of your flight. In the unlikely event of an evacuation you will be expected to assist in the opening of the emergency door. Therefore passengers sitting in an exit row must: be over the age of 16 yearsbe fit, strong and able to assist in the unlikely event of an evacuation of the aircraft during an emergencybe able to understand instructions given in Englishbe willing to assist in the unlikely event of an emergencyhave the capability to perform the required tasks without assistance of a companion, parent or other relativesnot have a condition or responsibility that might prevent them from performing these functions or cause them to suffer bodily harm while performing these functionsnot be pregnantnot be travelling with someone who needs their assistance in an emergencynot be travelling with a babynot be travelling with a pet in the cabin Our airport staff/cabin crew will verify that each passenger meets the emergency exit row seating requirements. Our airport staff/cabin crew is entitled to allocate another seat to passengers not meeting the necessary requirements. Please also note that any hand luggage must be stowed in the overhead lockers because no objects must be in the seating area or under the seats of an emergency exit row. Flights operated by the Lufthansa Group, Lufthansa Regional (Air Dolomiti, Lufthansa CityLine) and Discover Airlines HON Circle Members and Senators who are travelling with up to eight people on the same booking number can reserve seats free of charge in all booking classes (except on the Economy Basic and Light fare on short- and medium-haul flights and Economy Light fare bookings on long-haul flights). Flights operated by Edelweiss HON Circle Members who are travelling with up to eight people on the same booking number can reserve seats free of charge in all booking classes. If we have to change the seat you reserved in advance (e.g. for operational reasons), we will endeavour to reserve an equivalent new seat for you. In such cases, priority is given to passengers who are travelling together, e.g. families sitting next to one another. After this, seats with extra legroom in the emergency exit rows, aisle, window and then middle seats will be allocated in that order. If we cannot allocate a seat in the same category (e.g. by the aisle, window, or a seat with extra legroom), you can arrange a refund of the fee paid via the Lufthansa Service Center. If you have an existing advance seat reservation, you can rebook or cancel your ticket easily and conveniently yourself via “My bookings”. To My bookings Please note that a confirmed advance seat reservation does not guarantee you a specific seat on board the aircraft (e.g. seat 3A). The advance seat reservation refers to the chosen seat category (e.g. Classic Seat, Preferred Zone Seat, Extra Legroom Seat, etc.). An advance seat reservation applies to a single leg of your flight. Please note that advance seat reservations are not refundable, either at the airport or on board. When you book a seat in an emergency exit row, you must be able to meet the legal requirements. These will be explained to you during the booking process. Should you not meet these requirements, you will be allocated a different seat and you are not entitled to a refund. If your advance seat reservation is changed unexpectedly, the following cancellation and refund conditions apply: In the event of an operational change (e.g. a change of aircraft type or travel route), we will try to rebook you in the same seat category you have previously booked. However, the seat number you chose before may change. If we are unable to rebook you in the same seat category, your advance seat reservation is refundable. Your advance seat reservation is also refundable if we cancel your flight. If you make changes to your booking yourself, the following conditions apply to cancellations and refunds: Changing your advance seat reservation without changing your flight If you have made an advanced seat reservation for your flight and wish to change your seat, price differences may occur regardless of the selected seat category. If the price for the newly selected seat is higher, the difference must be paid. Changing your advance seat reservation and your flight If you change your flight and the route remains the same, you can transfer your advance seat reservation to the new flight. This can result in price differences regardless of the seat category selected. If the price for the newly selected seat is higher, the price difference must be paid. Should you also change your flight route, you may incur additional costs. Refund for your advance seat reservation without your flight being refunded Advance seat reservations alone are not refunded. However, if you have purchased an upgrade to a higher travel class, the advance seat reservation you previously purchased is refundable. Free upgrades that we offer as a goodwill gesture or for operational reasons do not entitle you to a refund for your prior advance seat reservation. Refund of your advance seat reservation together with the cancellation and refund of the flight A refund of the advance seat reservation together with a flight cancellation is possible if the fare conditions allow for a refund. Please note that for unused tickets, the following refund conditions apply: Continental routes: If your first flight allows for a refund, but the second flight does not, a refund for the second flight and advance seat reservation is not possible. If your second flight allows for a refund, the ticket and advance seat reservation can be refunded in the event of a cancellation. Intercontinental routes: Just as the fare conditions of a flight leg do not allow for a refund, the advance seat reservation for the unused leg is also non-refundable, regardless of whether this is the outbound or return flight. If you are travelling with children between the ages of two and 11, we will do our best to seat your child next to an adult in your group. These seats are allocated free of charge at check-in. You can, of course, reserve seats for your family in advance for a fee to ensure that you are all sitting together. For Lufthansa Allegris flights in Business Class especially, we strongly recommend that you reserve your seats early, as there are only limited options available for you to sit together. On flights to and from Canada, if we are not able to seat your child near an adult in your group, you can rebook your flight or cancel your trip. Under the regulations of ENAC (Ente Nazionale per l’Aviazione Civile [Italian Civil Aviation Authority]), we would like to make you aware that you are entitled to free advance seat reservations on flights to and from Italy if you fulfil the following conditions: you are travelling with a child between the ages of two and 12; and/oryou are a passenger with a disability or are accompanying a passenger with a disability. The Lufthansa Group will then seat you together free of charge at check-in. Do you have further questions? View terms and conditions Need help? Our Service Center is here to assist you. Contact us

/de/en/prepare-for-your-trip/baggage/car.text: Carry-on baggage rules at Lufthansa To help your flight depart on time and for your comfort on board, please note our baggage regulations regarding the permitted amount, dimensions and maximum weight in your travel class. Once on board, it’s best to stow small items of carry-on baggage under the seat in front of you. Important information for flights departing from the USA and connecting flights Under TSA (Transportation Security Administration) requirements, passengers departing from the USA may take only one carry-on baggage and one personal item through security – regardless of travel class or frequent flyer status. Any additional carry-on baggage must be checked in before the TSA security checkpoint. This also applies to connecting flights after arrival in the USA. The applicable rules of the operating airline apply. Carry-on baggage regulations according to travel class Short- and medium-haul Economy Basic 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm Economy Light, Comfort, Comfort Green & Flex 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 1 item of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Business Comfort, Comfort Green & Flex 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 2 items of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Long-haul Economy 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 1 item of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Premium Economy 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 1 item of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Business 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 2 items of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm First 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 2 items of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Depending on the type of aircraft used or the safety requirements of national authorities, there may be further restrictions in exceptional cases. Where appropriate, such restrictions also apply to our First Class and Business Class passengers. The permitted amount of carry-on baggage for HON Circle Members, Senators, Frequent Travellers and passengers with Star Alliance Gold or Silver status is determined by the respective travel class (with the exception of the Economy Basic Fare on short- and medium-haul flights). Miles & More members with HON Circle or Senator status, as well as Star Alliance Gold status, are allowed to take one piece of carry-on baggage into the cabin free of charge, in addition to their personal item, when traveling on the Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights. Other items of baggage allowed in the cabin The following special items may only be taken on board as part of your permitted carry-on baggage allowance: Folding garment bag (max. 57 x 54 x 15 cm and 8 kg) Foldable children’s buggy 1 per toddler (“pocket buggy”) Purchases made in the Duty Free area* Small musical instruments (height + width + length = max. 125 cm and 8 kg) Please note that the Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights includes only one personal item (40 x 30 x 15 cm). Special rules apply to the transportation of musical instruments. Information on the transportation of musical instruments * Your purchases made in the Duty Free area are not considered an additional permitted item of baggage and in this regard the permitted amount of carry-on baggage may not be exceeded. In addition to the permitted amount of carry-on baggage for their travel class, adults and children with their own seats may take the following items on board free of charge: One baby bassinet or child seat per small child Mobility aids, such as walkers, orthopaedic aids and other prosthetics, as well as medical equipment Particular rules apply to the transportation of mobility aids and medical equipment Information about the transportation of mobility aids Information about the transportation of medical equipment Non-compliant carry-on baggage and carry-on baggage on flights with high occupancy By transporting less carry-on baggage and making sure it complies with the rules, you can avoid long waiting times at security, enjoy more comfort on board and help your flight depart on time. This is why we check the amount, weight and dimensions of your carry-on baggage at the airport. Please note that any piece of baggage brought to the gate counts as carry-on baggage. This applies regardless of your checked baggage allowance. What happens if there is too much carry-on baggage: If your carry-on baggage does not comply with the rules, we will take it from you at the check-in counter or when you are boarding at the gate and transport it in the aircraft hold at your expense. The fees for this are significantly higher than for checked baggage booked in advance and can only be paid by credit card. The fees depend on the route and range from EUR 60 / CHF 60 / USD 75 to EUR 110 / CHF 110 / USD 125.In the case of flights with high occupancy, some of the compliant carry-on baggage must also be loaded into the hold due to limited storage space on board. We will inform you of this by email before your flight and give you the option of dropping off your compliant carry-on baggage at check-in free of charge. In both the above cases, please take out your valuables, any medicines required on the journey and any battery-powered devices such as tablets, smartphones, laptops, power banks or e-cigarettes and take them with you into the cabin. Further information about dangerous goods Stowing carry-on baggage correctly on board Clear aisles and the efficient use of overhead bins prevent trip hazards and help ensure speedy boarding. How best to stow your carry-on baggage: Large items of carry-on baggage Please stow large items of carry-on baggage, such as trolleys, in the most space-saving way possible in the overhead bins. Personal items Personal items, such as handbags, shopping bags or laptop bags, are best stowed under the seat in front of you. Jackets and coats Jackets and coats can be hung conveniently on the hook on the seat in front of you. Important: The overhead bins above the emergency exit rows are reserved for the passengers who are sitting there. On fully booked flights on smaller aircraft you may, in exceptional cases, have to check in larger items of carry-on baggage. These will be returned to you at the aircraft steps when you disembark. This will be for your safety and comfort. Special regional regulations and exceptions Some countries, such as the USA, for example, have stricter rules regarding carry-on baggage. On certain regional flights or where country-specific variations apply (e.g. flights from India and the USA), First and Business Class passengers must also check in their second item of carry-on baggage. Please also note our list of prohibited and dangerous goods. Before your flight, check the local regulations on your airport’s website. To the list of prohibited and dangerous goods Loading... FAQs on carry-on baggage If you are travelling with several airlines, the carry-on baggage rules of the respective operating airline apply to the individual flights. For example, even on a flight with a Lufthansa flight number (e.g. LH123) that is operated by another airline, the carry-on baggage regulations of the operating airline apply. Before your trip, please check the carry-on baggage rules for your flights on the websites of the operating airlines and follow the most restrictive rules. If your carry-on baggage has to be loaded into the hold due to limited storage space on board, it will first be given a baggage tag, as is the case with checked baggage. Then, at your destination airport, you can collect your baggage as usual from the baggage carrousel. Please take out your valuables, any medicines required on the journey and any battery-powered devices such as tablets, smartphones, laptops, power banks or e-cigarettes before your carry-on baggage is loaded into the hold. You can take them with you into the cabin among your personal items. Transportation of dangerous goods in carry-on baggage For safety reasons, it is forbidden by law to transport certain items in your carry-on baggage. Prohibited items will be confiscated at the airport security check. No exceptions will be made. This also applies to items purchased at the airport prior to departure. Lufthansa accepts no liability for confiscated items. That is why it is important that, before your trip, you acquaint yourself thoroughly with the rules and pack correctly.In this way you can avoid any hassle or losses. To the list of dangerous and prohibited goods In addition to the dangerous goods listed, some other dangerous goods are prohibited for transport for safety reasons. Transportation of fluids in carry-on baggage The transportation of fluids in carry-on baggage is subject to special legal regulations. The following regulations apply to flights within the EU (including German domestic flights) and connecting flights from the EU: Containers with liquids and gel-like substances may hold up to 100 ml (maximum capacity must be printed on container).Please note that this rule applies to the maximum capacity printed and not the actual contents.All containers must be transported in one resealable, clear plastic bag per person, the bag having a maximum capacity of 1 litre. What is considered liquid in carry-on baggage? Liquids include pastes, lotions, mixtures of liquids and solids, as well as the contents of pressure containers, such as toothpaste, hair gel, drinks, soups, syrup, perfume, shaving foam and other items with a similar consistency, as well as sprays, aerosols and gels. What exceptions are there? Special foods: Urgently required medicines and special foods in liquid form (e.g. baby food) may also be transported in carry-on baggage outside the plastic bag. However, you may only take the amount you will require during the flight. We recommend a medical certificate in English for important medication. Duty Free items: On connecting flights via an EU airport, liquid Duty Free items purchased at an international airport or on board an aircraft outside the EU must be transported in a sealed security bag provided at the point of purchase. The sales receipt must be enclosed in the bag.Special regulations for flights to the USA: Passengers with a connecting flight within the USA must stow liquid Duty Free items in their checked and registered baggage after landing in the USA. Items and containers that do not adhere to the dimensions may not be taken on board in carry-on baggage and will be disposed of at airport security. The regulations are statutory requirements. The local interpretation is the responsibility of the relevant authorities. Lufthansa has no influence in this regard. Before your flight, please also check on the website of your departure airport which local regulations apply.
