/gb/en/common/baggage-conditions.solo_co.text: Terms and Conditions for booking additional pieces of baggage 1.1 General conditions Passengers have the option of booking additional pieces of baggage for a fee. 1.2 Eligibility conditions The offer only applies to passengers who have a booking with a flight number from Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, or Air Dolomiti, and where the flight is operated by Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, Discover Airlines or Air Dolomiti (or a wet-leasing partner) and to passengers with a valid ticket. For other operating airlines, baggage rules and fees may vary.The extra bag charge applies to one-way flights to the final destination.The booked baggage must not exceed the standard weight of 23 kg and the standard dimensions of 158 cm (H+L+W). For baggage that exceeds the standard weight or the standard dimensions, the applicable excess baggage rate will be calculated at the airport.The baggage booking does not apply to the transport of animals or to sports equipment.Additional baggage can be paid for at the time of booking your flight or after booking up to two (2) hours before departure via My Bookings.The number of items of baggage that you can book is restricted. Passengers can book up to five (5) additional pieces of baggage, depending on the route.In addition, one additional piece of baggage that exceeds the standard weight of 23 kg (max. 32 kg), or the standard size of 158 cm (max. 292 cm (H+L+W)), or both, can be booked.Additional baggage can also be booked at the airport either at the ticket desk or check-in desk at a higher price. The additional baggage fees are charged in the currency of the country you are departing from.Lufthansa reserves the right to change or to modify fares or the existing terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.The receipt for your extra bag booking must be retained up until the end of your journey, and must be presented upon request at the ticket or check-in desk at the airport . The receipt will be sent to you via email to the address given during the purchasing process.The additional baggage booking is only valid for the flight shown on the receipt on the stated date. If the flight is rebooked, the booked additional item of baggage is no longer valid, except under the circumstances described below under «Rebooking and refunds».Additional baggage booking charges are not refundable except under the circumstances described below under ‘Rebooking and refunds’.All baggage is transported in accordance with the Lufthansa General Terms and Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage. Special rules for booking additional items of baggage Continental flights: Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights: The Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights includes only one personal item (40 x 30 x 15 cm) that may be taken into the aircraft cabin. Passengers have the option to add one (1) piece of carry-on baggage with a maximum weight of 8 kg and dimensions of 55 x 40 x 23 cm for a fee, either online via My Bookings or through the Service Center.The Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights does not include any free checked baggage. Lufthansa offers the benefit of a reduced price for the first piece of checked baggage (23 kg, total dimensions 158 cm). This applies only to passengers holding a booking with a Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, or Air Dolomiti flight number, and whose flight is operated by Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, Air Dolomiti, or Discover Airlines (or a wet-lease partner).Miles & More members with HON Circle, Senators, as well as Star Alliance Gold status have the option of taking one piece of carry-on baggage into the cabin free of charge in addition to a personal item when traveling on an Economy Basic fare on short- and medium haul flights. Adding a second piece of carry-on baggage for a fee is not permitted. Economy Light fare The Light fare does not include a checked free baggage allowance. On the Economy Class Light fare, Lufthansa offers you the additional benefit of a discount on the first bag (23 kg, overall 158 cm). Applies only to passengers who have a booking with a flight number for Lufthansa/SWISS/Brussels/ Austrian Airlines or Air Dolomiti, where the flight is operated by Lufthansa/SWISS/Austrian/Brussels Airlines/Air Dolomiti or Discover Airlines (or a wet-leasing partner) and who hold a valid ticket for an Economy Light fare.Miles & More members with Frequent Traveller, Senator or HON Circle status, as well as Star Alliance Gold members, enjoy higher free baggage allowances. However, the higher free baggage allowances do not apply to flights with Economy Light fares. Intercontinental flights: Economy Light fare The Light fare does not include a checked free baggage allowance. On the Economy Class Light fare, Lufthansa offers you the additional benefit of a discount on the first bag (23 kg, overall 158 cm). Applies only to passengers who have a booking with a flight number for Lufthansa/SWISS/Brussels/ Austrian Airlines or Air Dolomiti, where the flight is operated by Lufthansa/SWISS/Austrian/Brussels Airlines/Air Dolomiti or Discover Airlines (or a wet-leasing partner) and who hold a valid ticket for an Economy Light fare.Miles & More members with HON Circle, Senator and Star Alliance Gold status on intercontinental routes* have the option of taking the first piece of baggage free of charge on the Economy Light fare. Free carriage can only be registered at the check-in counter. If the baggage on the Economy Light fares is booked online, via the Service Center or via a travel agency, corresponding charges will apply.On some flight routes**, you will benefit from reduced rates for a second item of baggage (23 kg, 158 cm dimensions) on the Lufthansa Economy fare.Miles & More members with Frequent Traveller, Senator and HON Circle status, as well as Star Alliance Gold members, can enjoy higher free baggage allowances. However, in this case and on these flight routes, the reduced booking fee for the second item of baggage does not apply; the regular price for additional baggage bookings applies to each additional checked item of baggage. Further information and details about advance seat reservation The flight must be operated by Lufthansa Group airlines, Lufthansa Regional (Air Dolomiti,Lufthansa City Airlines), Lufthansa Express Rail (DB), Edelweiss, or Discover Airlines.Your flight booking is confirmed (no waiting list bookings).If you did not select your seat during the booking process, you can also do so after completing your booking. Access your trip under My bookings, and book or change your seat there. Reserve a seat now You will be allocated a seat automatically during online check-in if you did not choose a seat in advance. You can change it for a fee depending on the fare and seat category selected. This fee is not payable by passengers who have booked a seat in advance, providing the newly selected seat is of the same or a lower seat category. Please note that a confirmed advance seat reservation does not guarantee you a specific seat on board the aircraft (e.g. seat 3A). It only refers to the category selected (e.g. Classic Seat, Preferred Zone Seat, Extra Legroom Seat, etc.). An advance seat reservation applies to a single leg of your flight. In the unlikely event of an evacuation you will be expected to assist in the opening of the emergency door. Therefore passengers sitting in an exit row must: be over the age of 16 yearsbe fit, strong and able to assist in the unlikely event of an evacuation of the aircraft during an emergencybe able to understand instructions given in Englishbe willing to assist in the unlikely event of an emergencyhave the capability to perform the required tasks without assistance of a companion, parent or other relativesnot have a condition or responsibility that might prevent them from performing these functions or cause them to suffer bodily harm while performing these functionsnot be pregnantnot be travelling with someone who needs their assistance in an emergencynot be travelling with a babynot be travelling with a pet in the cabin Our airport staff/cabin crew will verify that each passenger meets the emergency exit row seating requirements. Our airport staff/cabin crew is entitled to allocate another seat to passengers not meeting the necessary requirements. Please also note that any hand luggage must be stowed in the overhead lockers because no objects must be in the seating area or under the seats of an emergency exit row. Flights operated by the Lufthansa Group, Lufthansa Regional (Air Dolomiti, Lufthansa CityLine) and Discover Airlines HON Circle Members and Senators who are travelling with up to eight people on the same booking number can reserve seats free of charge in all booking classes (except on the Economy Basic and Light fare on short- and medium-haul flights and Economy Light fare bookings on long-haul flights). Flights operated by Edelweiss HON Circle Members who are travelling with up to eight people on the same booking number can reserve seats free of charge in all booking classes. If we have to change the seat you reserved in advance (e.g. for operational reasons), we will endeavour to reserve an equivalent new seat for you. In such cases, priority is given to passengers who are travelling together, e.g. families sitting next to one another. After this, seats with extra legroom in the emergency exit rows, aisle, window and then middle seats will be allocated in that order. If we cannot allocate a seat in the same category (e.g. by the aisle, window, or a seat with extra legroom), you can arrange a refund of the fee paid via the Lufthansa Service Center. If you have an existing advance seat reservation, you can rebook or cancel your ticket easily and conveniently yourself via “My bookings”. To My bookings Please note that a confirmed advance seat reservation does not guarantee you a specific seat on board the aircraft (e.g. seat 3A). The advance seat reservation refers to the chosen seat category (e.g. Classic Seat, Preferred Zone Seat, Extra Legroom Seat, etc.). An advance seat reservation applies to a single leg of your flight. Please note that advance seat reservations are not refundable, either at the airport or on board. When you book a seat in an emergency exit row, you must be able to meet the legal requirements. These will be explained to you during the booking process. Should you not meet these requirements, you will be allocated a different seat and you are not entitled to a refund. If your advance seat reservation is changed unexpectedly, the following cancellation and refund conditions apply: In the event of an operational change (e.g. a change of aircraft type or travel route), we will try to rebook you in the same seat category you have previously booked. However, the seat number you chose before may change. If we are unable to rebook you in the same seat category, your advance seat reservation is refundable. Your advance seat reservation is also refundable if we cancel your flight. If you make changes to your booking yourself, the following conditions apply to cancellations and refunds: Changing your advance seat reservation without changing your flight If you have made an advanced seat reservation for your flight and wish to change your seat, price differences may occur regardless of the selected seat category. If the price for the newly selected seat is higher, the difference must be paid. Changing your advance seat reservation and your flight If you change your flight and the route remains the same, you can transfer your advance seat reservation to the new flight. This can result in price differences regardless of the seat category selected. If the price for the newly selected seat is higher, the price difference must be paid. Should you also change your flight route, you may incur additional costs. Refund for your advance seat reservation without your flight being refunded Advance seat reservations alone are not refunded. However, if you have purchased an upgrade to a higher travel class, the advance seat reservation you previously purchased is refundable. Free upgrades that we offer as a goodwill gesture or for operational reasons do not entitle you to a refund for your prior advance seat reservation. Refund of your advance seat reservation together with the cancellation and refund of the flight A refund of the advance seat reservation together with a flight cancellation is possible if the fare conditions allow for a refund. Please note that for unused tickets, the following refund conditions apply: Continental routes: If your first flight allows for a refund, but the second flight does not, a refund for the second flight and advance seat reservation is not possible. If your second flight allows for a refund, the ticket and advance seat reservation can be refunded in the event of a cancellation. Intercontinental routes: Just as the fare conditions of a flight leg do not allow for a refund, the advance seat reservation for the unused leg is also non-refundable, regardless of whether this is the outbound or return flight. If you are travelling with children between the ages of two and 11, we will do our best to seat your child next to an adult in your group. These seats are allocated free of charge at check-in. You can, of course, reserve seats for your family in advance for a fee to ensure that you are all sitting together. For Lufthansa Allegris flights in Business Class especially, we strongly recommend that you reserve your seats early, as there are only limited options available for you to sit together. On flights to and from Canada, if we are not able to seat your child near an adult in your group, you can rebook your flight or cancel your trip. Under the regulations of ENAC (Ente Nazionale per l’Aviazione Civile [Italian Civil Aviation Authority]), we would like to make you aware that you are entitled to free advance seat reservations on flights to and from Italy if you fulfil the following conditions: you are travelling with a child between the ages of two and 12; and/oryou are a passenger with a disability or are accompanying a passenger with a disability. The Lufthansa Group will then seat you together free of charge at check-in. Do you have further questions? View terms and conditions Need help? Our Service Center is here to assist you. Contact us

/gb/en/prepare-for-your-trip/baggage/car.text: Carry-on baggage rules at Lufthansa To help your flight depart on time and for your comfort on board, please note our baggage regulations regarding the permitted amount, dimensions and maximum weight in your travel class. Once on board, it’s best to stow small items of carry-on baggage under the seat in front of you. Important information for flights departing from the USA and connecting flights Under TSA (Transportation Security Administration) requirements, passengers departing from the USA may take only one carry-on baggage and one personal item through security – regardless of travel class or frequent flyer status. Any additional carry-on baggage must be checked in before the TSA security checkpoint. This also applies to connecting flights after arrival in the USA. The applicable rules of the operating airline apply. Carry-on baggage regulations according to travel class Short- and medium-haul Economy Basic 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm Economy Light, Comfort, Comfort Green & Flex 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 1 item of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Business Comfort, Comfort Green & Flex 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 2 items of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Long-haul Economy 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 1 item of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Premium Economy 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 1 item of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Business 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 2 items of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm First 1 personal item max. 40 x 30 x 15 cm 2 items of carry-on baggage max. 8 kg max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm Depending on the type of aircraft used or the safety requirements of national authorities, there may be further restrictions in exceptional cases. Where appropriate, such restrictions also apply to our First Class and Business Class passengers. The permitted amount of carry-on baggage for HON Circle Members, Senators, Frequent Travellers and passengers with Star Alliance Gold or Silver status is determined by the respective travel class (with the exception of the Economy Basic Fare on short- and medium-haul flights). Miles & More members with HON Circle or Senator status, as well as Star Alliance Gold status, are allowed to take one piece of carry-on baggage into the cabin free of charge, in addition to their personal item, when traveling on the Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights. Other items of baggage allowed in the cabin The following special items may only be taken on board as part of your permitted carry-on baggage allowance: Folding garment bag (max. 57 x 54 x 15 cm and 8 kg) Foldable children’s buggy 1 per toddler (“pocket buggy”) Purchases made in the Duty Free area* Small musical instruments (height + width + length = max. 125 cm and 8 kg) Please note that the Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights includes only one personal item (40 x 30 x 15 cm). Special rules apply to the transportation of musical instruments. Information on the transportation of musical instruments * Your purchases made in the Duty Free area are not considered an additional permitted item of baggage and in this regard the permitted amount of carry-on baggage may not be exceeded. In addition to the permitted amount of carry-on baggage for their travel class, adults and children with their own seats may take the following items on board free of charge: One baby bassinet or child seat per small child Mobility aids, such as walkers, orthopaedic aids and other prosthetics, as well as medical equipment Particular rules apply to the transportation of mobility aids and medical equipment Information about the transportation of mobility aids Information about the transportation of medical equipment Non-compliant carry-on baggage and carry-on baggage on flights with high occupancy By transporting less carry-on baggage and making sure it complies with the rules, you can avoid long waiting times at security, enjoy more comfort on board and help your flight depart on time. This is why we check the amount, weight and dimensions of your carry-on baggage at the airport. Please note that any piece of baggage brought to the gate counts as carry-on baggage. This applies regardless of your checked baggage allowance. What happens if there is too much carry-on baggage: If your carry-on baggage does not comply with the rules, we will take it from you at the check-in counter or when you are boarding at the gate and transport it in the aircraft hold at your expense. The fees for this are significantly higher than for checked baggage booked in advance and can only be paid by credit card. The fees depend on the route and range from EUR 60 / CHF 60 / USD 75 to EUR 110 / CHF 110 / USD 125.In the case of flights with high occupancy, some of the compliant carry-on baggage must also be loaded into the hold due to limited storage space on board. We will inform you of this by email before your flight and give you the option of dropping off your compliant carry-on baggage at check-in free of charge. In both the above cases, please take out your valuables, any medicines required on the journey and any battery-powered devices such as tablets, smartphones, laptops, power banks or e-cigarettes and take them with you into the cabin. Further information about dangerous goods Stowing carry-on baggage correctly on board Clear aisles and the efficient use of overhead bins prevent trip hazards and help ensure speedy boarding. How best to stow your carry-on baggage: Large items of carry-on baggage Please stow large items of carry-on baggage, such as trolleys, in the most space-saving way possible in the overhead bins. Personal items Personal items, such as handbags, shopping bags or laptop bags, are best stowed under the seat in front of you. Jackets and coats Jackets and coats can be hung conveniently on the hook on the seat in front of you. Important: The overhead bins above the emergency exit rows are reserved for the passengers who are sitting there. On fully booked flights on smaller aircraft you may, in exceptional cases, have to check in larger items of carry-on baggage. These will be returned to you at the aircraft steps when you disembark. This will be for your safety and comfort. Special regional regulations and exceptions Some countries, such as the USA, for example, have stricter rules regarding carry-on baggage. On certain regional flights or where country-specific variations apply (e.g. flights from India and the USA), First and Business Class passengers must also check in their second item of carry-on baggage. Please also note our list of prohibited and dangerous goods. Before your flight, check the local regulations on your airport’s website. To the list of prohibited and dangerous goods Loading... FAQs on carry-on baggage If you are travelling with several airlines, the carry-on baggage rules of the respective operating airline apply to the individual flights. For example, even on a flight with a Lufthansa flight number (e.g. LH123) that is operated by another airline, the carry-on baggage regulations of the operating airline apply. Before your trip, please check the carry-on baggage rules for your flights on the websites of the operating airlines and follow the most restrictive rules. If your carry-on baggage has to be loaded into the hold due to limited storage space on board, it will first be given a baggage tag, as is the case with checked baggage. Then, at your destination airport, you can collect your baggage as usual from the baggage carrousel. Please take out your valuables, any medicines required on the journey and any battery-powered devices such as tablets, smartphones, laptops, power banks or e-cigarettes before your carry-on baggage is loaded into the hold. You can take them with you into the cabin among your personal items. Transportation of dangerous goods in carry-on baggage For safety reasons, it is forbidden by law to transport certain items in your carry-on baggage. Prohibited items will be confiscated at the airport security check. No exceptions will be made. This also applies to items purchased at the airport prior to departure. Lufthansa accepts no liability for confiscated items. That is why it is important that, before your trip, you acquaint yourself thoroughly with the rules and pack correctly.In this way you can avoid any hassle or losses. To the list of dangerous and prohibited goods In addition to the dangerous goods listed, some other dangerous goods are prohibited for transport for safety reasons. Transportation of fluids in carry-on baggage The transportation of fluids in carry-on baggage is subject to special legal regulations. The following regulations apply to flights within the EU (including German domestic flights) and connecting flights from the EU: Containers with liquids and gel-like substances may hold up to 100 ml (maximum capacity must be printed on container).Please note that this rule applies to the maximum capacity printed and not the actual contents.All containers must be transported in one resealable, clear plastic bag per person, the bag having a maximum capacity of 1 litre. What is considered liquid in carry-on baggage? Liquids include pastes, lotions, mixtures of liquids and solids, as well as the contents of pressure containers, such as toothpaste, hair gel, drinks, soups, syrup, perfume, shaving foam and other items with a similar consistency, as well as sprays, aerosols and gels. What exceptions are there? Special foods: Urgently required medicines and special foods in liquid form (e.g. baby food) may also be transported in carry-on baggage outside the plastic bag. However, you may only take the amount you will require during the flight. We recommend a medical certificate in English for important medication. Duty Free items: On connecting flights via an EU airport, liquid Duty Free items purchased at an international airport or on board an aircraft outside the EU must be transported in a sealed security bag provided at the point of purchase. The sales receipt must be enclosed in the bag.Special regulations for flights to the USA: Passengers with a connecting flight within the USA must stow liquid Duty Free items in their checked and registered baggage after landing in the USA. Items and containers that do not adhere to the dimensions may not be taken on board in carry-on baggage and will be disposed of at airport security. The regulations are statutory requirements. The local interpretation is the responsibility of the relevant authorities. Lufthansa has no influence in this regard. Before your flight, please also check on the website of your departure airport which local regulations apply.

/gb/en/prepare-for-your-trip/baggage/bag.text: Problems with baggage Delayed baggage Sometimes, you may arrive at your destination and find that an item of baggage cannot be traced. You can find the most important information, links and contact details for such cases below. Rest assured that we will forward your delayed baggage as quickly as possible. We thank you for your understanding and patience and apologise for any inconvenience caused. Loading... Procedure for delayed baggage Delayed baggage? What happens now Please report your delayed baggage immediately online or to baggage tracing at the airport. Report delayed baggage The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. You can check the status of your baggage online using your reference number. Here you can also subscribe to baggage status updates. Check baggage status The link will be opened in a new browser tab Baggage tracing and forwarding As soon as you have reported your delayed baggage, our baggage tracing team will progress the matter. If your baggage is traced, it will be forwarded to the destination airport for your journey and processed further there. Delivery of your delayed baggage When your baggage arrives at your destination airport, further internal procedures and customs clearance will still require some time. We will then send you all the information you need about delivery or collection. Handover of your delayed baggage Your baggage will be delivered to the delivery address you provided or you can collect it from the airport if you have chosen this option. Please only come to the airport when you are contacted about this. Frequently asked questions about delayed baggage If you have not received your baggage by the time the baggage reclaim has ended, please report this immediately before leaving the airport. At most airports this can be done online or at the baggage tracing desk. Report delayed baggage The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. If you have already received a notification about your delayed baggage by email, text message or app, you can also use the link provided to complete a pre-filled form. In the app of your Lufthansa Group airline, you will also find this link to a pre-filled form under “Baggage details”, which you can use to quickly report your delayed baggage - saving you time and clicks. Once you have reported your delayed baggage, you will receive written confirmation by email with a reference number (PIR no., e.g. FRALH12345). We recommend that you remain at the airport until your details have been successfully transmitted and you have received a reference number. Please retain this together with your flight documents, in particular your boarding pass and the baggage receipt. Your baggage will be sent on and delivered to you as quickly as possible. You can check the current status of your delayed baggage report at any time with our ​Chat AssistantThe link will be opened in a new browser tab. Make sure that you also subscribe to baggage status updates when you create a delayed baggage report to receive these directly via email. If you do not receive any baggage status updates, you can also activate these later via our ​Chat AssistantThe link will be opened in a new browser tab. You can check the progress in tracing your baggage via our ​Chat AssistantThe link will be opened in a new browser tab using your reference number (PIR no., e.g. FRALH12345). You can also amend your contact details. In particular, if the delivery address is incorrect or has changed, please be sure to update it here. We need this to deliver your baggage. If you are unable to get the information you require or cannot amend your details using the link provided, you will find a contact telephone number on the written confirmation receipt of your missing baggage report. (You will receive the written confirmation of your delayed baggage report at the baggage tracing desk or attached to the confirmation email after you have reported your delayed baggage online.) At certain times of the year, such as during the peak travel season, there may be delays with delivery. However, we will make every effort to ensure speedy processing and ask for your understanding. In the rare case that your baggage cannot be found within five days of reporting the delay, we will require a detailed description of your baggage and its contents to initiate a detailed search. This will compare the information you entered, including the list of contents, with the information we collected to find your baggage among baggage that has not yet been identified. Please complete the list of contents on our baggage status page. You will be able to access this automatically five days after reporting your delayed baggage. To the baggage status page The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. If your baggage arrives late at your destination, you can purchase essential items such as toiletries and clothes, and submit the receipts for reimbursement. Please keep all the receipts to support your claim later. After you have reported your delayed baggage (at the airport or online), please request a refund of verified costs by using this form to request reimbursement in the event of baggage irregularities. To the request for reimbursement The link will be opened in a new browser tab Important: We recommend that you carry valuables such as jewellery, money or medicines in your carry-on baggage.You are obliged to keep the cost of replacement items as low as possible in the event of a baggage delay (“duty to mitigate damages”). Lufthansa will contribute to the costs subject to proportionality.Expenses for replacement purchases made after your arrival back home may be considered for reimbursement. Please note that as a passenger, you are particularly obligated here to behave in a way that mitigates damages. Expenses for replacement purchases that can be assumed to be present at home will not be reimbursed.Items that you can continue to use (e.g. clothes) will be reimbursed at a rate of 50%, while toiletries or single-use items will be reimbursed at 100%.* * Exceptions apply to the USA and Canada due to local legislation (US DOT and CTA). You can apply for reimbursement of the costs of replacement items within two years of your flight, providing you have reported your baggage as delayed. You are entitled to compensation for the loss of your item of baggage providing you have reported your baggage as delayed within the reporting deadlines (at the airport or online), completed the contents list on the baggage status page, and your baggage has been delayed for more than 21 days. If this is the case, you must submit your claim for compensation for the loss of your baggage within two years. Please use this form to request a reimbursement. To the request for reimbursement The maximum amount that can be refunded in the event of the complete loss of your baggage is regulated by the Montreal Convention. Important: We recommend that you carry valuables such as jewellery, money or medicines in your carry-on baggage. You are responsible for your carry-on baggage. The liability of airlines for travel baggage is regulated by law. The compensation entitlement is granted according to the Montreal Convention. The compensation itself is specified in so-called Special Drawing Rights (SDR). The Special Drawing Right (SDR) is an artificial accounting unit created by the International Monetary Fund (IMF). Currently, the maximum liability amount is 1,519 SDRs which currently equates to approx. €1,900. This amount is subject to exchange rate fluctuations and may therefore change. The Montreal Convention only applies if the following conditions are met: The law applies both to domestic and international carriage between the contracting states. For checked baggage, the airline is liable for the baggage delay, irrespective of fault. This right only applies if the baggage delay report and the claim for compensation are submitted within the deadlines specified in the contract. If you have reported your baggage as delayed but it has since been retrieved (e.g. the bag arrived on the baggage carousel after you reported it), you can close the report using our ​Chat AssistantThe link will be opened in a new browser tab. When prompted by the Chat Assistant, please enter your reference number and your family name. This information is important so that the Chat Assistant can locate your report. If your report is eligible for closure based on its current status (i.e. processing or delivery has not yet started), the report will be closed and we will stop all tracing activities for your delayed baggage. Additional frequently asked questions about delayed baggage Damaged baggage We are sorry that your bag was damaged during carriage. We will ensure that the damage caused is repaired reliably and as quickly as possible. Please note the following information to ensure your case is processed quickly and smoothly. Loading... Damaged baggage? What happens now Please report your damaged baggage immediately online or to baggage tracing at the airport so that we can deal with your concern as quickly as possible. ​Report damaged baggage online up to three days after your flight The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. Processing of the damage claim Our service provider, Dolfi1920GmbH, will check your damage report and assess the damage in accordance with our rules. Once your damage report has been checked, you will be contacted about possible compensation. Completion of the damage report There are various compensation options depending on the nature of the damage to your bag. Your bag may possibly be repaired or replaced. Otherwise, you will receive compensation for the current value of your bag. Frequently asked questions about damaged baggage Please report to us immediately any bags damaged during carriage so that we can deal with your concern as quickly as possible. At most airports, the best option is to do this online or at the Lufthansa baggage tracing desk (“Lost and Found” at the airport). You will receive written confirmation with a reference number (PIR no., e.g. FRALH12345). Please be sure to keep this safe. If you do not notice the damage until after you arrive home or at your hotel, you must report it within seven days of your flight. ​Report damaged baggage online up to three days after your flight The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. ​Report damaged baggage if the online service is not available Report damaged wheelchair, mobility aid online If you discover damage to your bag, you must report it immediately. If you do not notice the damage until after you arrive home or at your hotel, report the damage online no later than seven days after receiving your checked baggage. You will receive confirmation by email with a reference number (e.g. FRALH12345) once you have reported your damaged bag. All further steps required will be listed in this confirmation. Dolfi1920 GmbH processes all baggage repairs, replacements and compensation payments for damaged baggage on behalf of Lufthansa. Once your damage report has been checked, Dolfi1920 GmbH will contact you about possible compensation. If you have not yet received any feedback, Lufthansa Feedback Management and the service provider need more time to process your report and will contact you as soon as possible. This will generally be within a few working days. Please be assured that we will be working actively on a quick solution once you have reported your damaged bag. The time required for the repair or replacement of your bag may vary depending on the total quantity of the damaged baggage processed by Dolfi1920 GmbH. Additional frequently asked questions about damaged baggage Loss of personal property Have you lost an item on board a Lufthansa flight to Germany or in a Lufthansa lounge at a German airport? In such cases, please contact the baggage tracing service responsible for Lufthansa at the respective airport: Frankfurt (FRA): Please use ​this formThe link will be opened in a new browser tab to report your loss. Alternatively, you can contact the lost property office in Terminal 1, Area A, Level 0. Opening hours: Daily, from 07:00 am to 06:00 pm Munich (MUC): Please use ​this formThe link will be opened in a new browser tab to report your loss. Alternatively, you can contact the lost property office at the Munich Airport (Terminal 2, Level 03, Arrivals). Opening hours: Daily from 7:00 am to 9:00 pm Berlin (BER): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​lostandfound_ber@aas.aeroThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Bremen (BRE): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​brell@ahs-aero.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Dresden (DRS): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​lofo.drs@fsg-airport-services.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Düsseldorf (DUS): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​dusllbag@ahs-aero.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Hamburg (HAM): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​hamll@ahs-aero.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Hanover (HAJ): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​hajll@ahs-aero.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Cologne/Bonn (CGN): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​cgnll@ahs-aero.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Leipzig/Halle (LEJ): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​lostandfound@fsg-airport-services.comThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Stuttgart (STR): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​strll@sgs-aero.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Sylt-Westerland (GWT): Please send lost property inquiries to: ​service@flughafen-sylt.deThe link will be opened in a new browser tab Important: Please have the following information ready: flight number, travel date, seat, and a description of the lost item. We will do everything we can to locate your item as quickly as possible. As soon as we do, we will contact you to arrange for its return. For inquiries about the processing status of your delayed or damaged baggage, please use only the self-service options or contact details on your lost or damaged baggage report. Have you lost an item on board one of our aircraft with a destination outside Germany? In this case, please contact the baggage tracing office at the respective airport immediately upon arrival. Important: Please have the following information ready: flight number, travel date, seat, and a description of the lost item. We will do everything we can to locate your item as quickly as possible. As soon as we succeed, we will contact you to arrange for its return. If individual items or the entire contents of your baggage are missing, you should report this immediately upon arrival: at the Lufthansa baggage tracing desk at the airport at the Lufthansa service counter at the airport orby using our contact form* To the request for reimbursement * Reporting the loss at a later date can only be accepted if this is done in writing online within seven days.

/gb/en/prepare-for-your-trip/baggage/exc.text: Excess baggage For excess and special baggage, flat rates apply. This is also the case for sports baggage that exceeds the free baggage allowance. In Economy and Premium Economy Class, a piece of baggage is considered to be excess baggage when it weighs more than 23 kg (up to a maximum of 32 kg) and/or is larger than 158 cm (the sum of width X + height Y + depth Z up to a maximum of 292 cm). In Business and First Class a piece of baggage is considered to be excess baggage when its total dimensions are greater than 158 cm up to a maximum of 292 cm. Booking and prices You will be charged the flat rates1 for excess baggage if your checked baggage corresponds to the allowed number of items but exceeds the permitted weight and/or dimensions, or if the number of checked pieces of baggage exceeds the allowance. On certain routes, as an Economy Class passenger you can benefit from discounted flat rates for the second piece of checked baggage (up to 23 kg/up to 158 cm). If you are travelling with another airline, please contact the operating airline directly for information about their excess baggage charges. Due to limited capacity and varying regulations at our partner airlines, we recommend making an early reservation for your excess baggage, either in your travel agencyor by calling the Service Center. To the Service Center If you need an additional piece of baggage in addition to your free baggage allowance, which is considered excess baggage due to its weight, size or both, you can also easily book this yourself online. Book an additional piece of baggage under “My Bookings” 1 Please note: depending upon the departure airport, local taxes may apply in addition to the Lufthansa flat rates stated. Make sure you have attached your name and (mobile) telephone number to each piece of baggage (inside and out) before checking it in at the airport. Bag tags and/or stickers for baggage items to be checked in can be obtained free of charge at the check-in counter. You are also welcome to use your own bag tags. Please observe the baggage check-in deadlines for your travel class and airport. To the baggage check-in deadlines As a general rule, the data we collect is used to fulfil the contract of carriage you have taken out with us. It includes both passenger and baggage data. To ensure the onward transportation of your baggage with other airlines, as well as its timely processing at airports, we pass data on to the airlines and airports concerned. In addition, we support the German Customs authorities in the fulfilment of their legal duties by allowing limited access to selected data. Items of baggage which weigh more than 32 kg will not be accepted as travel baggage. They can be sent by air freight. Please note that the maximum permitted weight per item of baggage can vary on flights with other airlines. Information about this can be obtained from the airline in question. Information about air freight is available from the respective local Lufthansa Cargo sales office. /gb/en/prepare-for-your-trip/baggage/dig.text: Digital baggage services With the Lufthansa app and our digital baggage services, you can enjoy the reassurance of knowing where your baggage is located throughout your journey. Baggage receipt and baggage status Immediately after dropping off your baggage at either the check-in counter or a self-service bag drop kiosk, it is very easy to call up your baggage receipt and baggage status using the mobile boarding pass on your smartphone. Your baggage receipt will be sent to you as a push notification in the Lufthansa app and/or by email. In the event of your baggage going astray, this baggage receipt serves as the starting point for locating your baggage. After your receipt has been displayed once, it will also be filed locally in the Lufthansa app so that you can refer to it at any time. Baggage carousel information After you have landed, a push notification will inform you which baggage carousel to go to in order to pick up your baggage. This service is currently available at a number of airports (e.g. Frankfurt, Hamburg, Munich, Stuttgart and Milan). Electronic Bag Tag With an Electronic Bag Tag you can easily and conveniently provide your baggage with the necessary bag tags for your flight yourself, either from home or when you’re on the move—and the entire process is completely digital. All you need to do this is a checked-in Lufthansa flight and an Electronic Bag Tag (from BAGTAG or a RIMOWA suitcase with built-in Electronic Bag Tag). In this way you can check in your baggage via app and drop it off at the airport within moments. More information about Electronic Bag Tags Bag drop-off at self-service bag drop kiosks In Frankfurt, Munich, Hamburg and Berlin as well as in Geneva, Vienna and at other selected airports outside Germany, there are self-service bag drop kiosks available to you where you can check in your baggage. As soon as you have your boarding pass, which you have issued either on your mobile phone or online, you can check in your baggage yourself very easily at the self-service bag drop kiosks. Issue boarding pass online You can find a list of airports with bag drop kiosks and their locations on the baggage check-in page: List of bag drop kiosks and their locations Our bag drop kiosks are easy to use, so you can check in your baggage conveniently yourself in just a few steps: Scan your boarding pass Print out the baggage tag at the machine and attach it to the item of baggageCheck in baggage and receive receipt You can then proceed to security check. Online notification of delayed baggage If your luggage is not delivered to you on the baggage carousel, you can report it as delayed, either online or via your Smartphone. It is very easy to access this service: by following the link sent to you by email or SMS via the Lufthansa appvia the ​Delayed Baggage ServiceThe link will be opened in a new browser tab We recommend that you remain at the airport until your details have been successfully transmitted. H3: Bag-Free Travel: Let Us Carry and Check In Your Bags
/gb/en/prepare-for-your-trip/baggage.sol.text: Baggage You can get all the important information about taking carry-on baggage, free baggage and special baggage on your flights with Lufthansa here. To types of baggage To baggage services Types of baggage Free baggage Find out about Lufthansa’s current free baggage rules. The free baggage allowance is based on the travel class and the fare you have booked. To free baggage allowance Carry-on baggage Whether it is the number of items, the weight or the security checks your carry-on baggage undergoes, Lufthansa will tell you everything you need to know about the subject here. To carry-on baggage Electronic devices and batteries Electronic devices and batteries are classed as dangerous goods. You can find detailed information about their carriage here. About electronic items and batteries Dangerous goods The carriage of certain items in checked baggage or carry-on baggage is prohibited by law. To dangerous goods Excess baggage In the case of excess baggage, there are a few things to bear in mind. You can find out all about this subject, as well as the flat rates, here. To excess baggage Sports baggage and special baggage Whether for snowboarding, surfing or golf, you’ll find all the information about registering your sports baggage and special baggage and the various transport options here. To sports baggage and special baggage Bag-Free Travel: Let Us Carry and Check In Your Bags Have you thought of everything? Then let us take care of your luggage. Our convenient baggage pick-up and check-in service, offered in partnership with Airportr, ensures your bags are effortlessly handled from your home or hotel right up to the baggage carousel at your destination. This service is available in Frankfurt, Zurich, London, and an increasing number of cities across the Lufthansa network, starting from as low as 25 EUR. No more carrying heavy bags on trains, no more struggling to fit everything in your car, and no more queuing at check-in bag drop. Travel hands-free on your next trip! Find out more here The link will be opened in a new browser tab Please note that with this link you are visiting an external website that may not follow the same privacy, security or accessibility policies. Baggage services Baggage Drop If you have already obtained your boarding pass in the Lufthansa app, via online check-in or at a check-in kiosk, you can easily check in your baggage at self-service baggage drop kiosks at many airports. About baggage drop Problems with baggage You can find out where to claim compensation for damage as well as where to get information about delayed items of baggage here. Help with baggage problems Further information Travel briefing Practical tips and services for preparation and for enjoying a care-free trips — from booking through to arrival at the destination. To Travel Briefing Travelling with animals You can find all the important information about registering your pets as well as the various options for transporting them here. To travelling with animals A healthy journey Lufthansa has compiled some important information for you here about the transport of medicines on board. To medical information

/gb/en/during-your-trip/lounges/admissio.text: Access to our lounges Wherever you’re flying with us, as our premium passenger, you have access to selected lounges throughout the world. Ultimately, we want to offer you a relaxed flying experience, regardless of where you are travelling from. To be able to use our lounges, you need to be in possession of a Miles & More status or a specific travel class, plus a valid boarding pass for the respective airport offering the lounge. /us/en/local-page/dnsmpi.solo_continue.text: Do Not Sell My Personal Information As a California resident, you have the right under the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (“CCPA”) to opt-out of the sale of your personal information. Whereas we do not sell any personal information in return for money, we do disclose it to a few of our service providers. Therefore, the link “Change Cookies Settings” in the footer of this website gives you the option to choose how we can use your personal information. If you decide not to allow any other than the necessary cookies, your personal information will remain with us only. Privacy Statement for California Residents

/us/en/local-page/ccpa.solo_continue.text: CCPA Statement and Do Not Sell My Personal Information This Privacy Statement for California Residents supplements Lufthansa’s Privacy Policy and applies to you if you reside in California. It provides information on your privacy rights according to the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (“CCPA”) where they either differ or go beyond what is stated in our Privacy Statement. Personal Information We collect the following data (table according to the CCPA): Category Examples Collection Disclosure Sale Identifiers Cookie ID, IP Address yes yes no Personal Information listed in the California Customer Records statue (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.80(e)) Name, postal address, passport number, medical information yes yes no Characteristics of Protected Classifications under California Law Gender, health yes yes no Commercial Information Products or services purchased yes yes no Biometric Information DNA, fingerprint, vein patterns no no no Internet or Other Electronic Network Activity Information Search history yes yes no Geolocation Data Physical location yes yes no Sensory Information Audio yes yes no Professional or employment-related information CV, job performance information yes yes no Non-Public Education Information Student information yes yes no Inferences Drawn from Personal Information Customer preferences yes yes no Collection and Disclosure of Personal Information As detailed in our Privacy Policy, we share your personal information with the following categories of CCPA third parties: Service providers Affiliates of the Lufthansa Group Airlines outside the Lufthansa Group Partner companies Third parties as required by law, such as authorities Use of Personal Information We use your Personal Information according to our Privacy Policy. Your CCPA Rights As a California resident, you have the following consumer rights: · Right to access your personal information · Right to deletion of your personal information · Right to prohibit the sale of your personal information · Right to non-discrimination for the exercise of your CCPA Rights, subject to certain exceptions To exercise your right to prohibit the sale of your personal information, please ​click hereThe link will be opened in a new browser tab. For all other requests please choose from the following: Contact If you have any further queries regarding data protection in connection with our website or the services offered there, please contact our data protection officer: Group Data Protection Officer for the Lufthansa Group Deutsche Lufthansa AG FRA CJ/D 60546 Frankfurt E-Mail: ​datenschutz@dlh.de Please address any request for information to: Deutsche Lufthansa AG Data Information FRA CJ/D 60546 Frankfurt or by e-mail to: ​datenauskunft@dlh.de If you contact us via email, the communication is unencrypted. Do Not Sell My Personal Information As a California resident, you have the right under the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (“CCPA”) to opt-out of the sale of your personal information. Whereas we do not sell any personal information in return for money, we do disclose it to a few of our service providers. Therefore, the link “Change Cookies Settings” in the footer of this website gives you the option to choose how we can use your personal information. /de/en/prepare-for-your-trip/check-in.so.text: Online check-in You can check in online from 30 hours before departure. Check in online now Loading... How to get your boarding pass 1 Find your booking Identify yourself using your name and 6-digit booking reference or ticket number. 2 Sign in with Travel ID Sign in with your existing Travel ID — or create one in just a few steps — to continue with online check-in. Create Travel ID 3 Complete your travel details Provide the required travel information and travel documents for your flight and destination. 4 Personalize your flight Select a seat for yourself and anyone travelling with you. Add available services such as baggage or upgrades. In case you don’t know the airline booking reference or the ticket number please use the following option to access the online check-in with the booking details received from your travel agency or tour operator. Online check-in with tour operator details The link will be opened in a new browser tab Experience a seamless travel experience with Travel ID One Travel ID for every trip Manage all your Lufthansa Group trips in one place, breeze through check-in, and enjoy free Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi powered by Starlink on eligible flights. Create or sign in to Travel ID Your check-in with Lufthansa Bag drop-off If you have already obtained your boarding pass on your smartphone, online or at a check-in counter, you have the option of checking in your baggage at a self-service bag drop kiosk.
